source: SenseFi benchmark, UT-HAR results published with its pretrained weights (models/sensefi/UT-HAR/UT-HAR_result)
reference: J. Yang, X. Chen, H. Zou, et al. SenseFi: A library and benchmark on deep-learning-empowered WiFi human sensing. Patterns, 2023. github.com/xyanchen/WiFi-CSI-Sensing-Benchmark
note: Accuracy on SenseFi's own UT-HAR test split, which is leaky (499 of its 500 test windows come from recordings that also supply training windows). Kept here only as a reproduction check; see results/eval_activity.json for the held-out recording results.
